notes:
Background:
- Mid-market B2B analytics SaaS; product helps product teams instrument user flows and generate insights. Growing ARR, expanding ML features roadmap.
- Eng/Product champion: Clara Mendes (Head of Product). Procurement & Legal involved after POC.

Trial summary (Hosted API, Nov 2025 - Feb 2026):
- Started Hosted API trial 2025-11-10 with 2 dev teams. Ran ~6 weeks of live traffic on staging then a limited production pilot.
- Observed steady-state QPS: 45 QPS average (weekday business hours), baseline concurrency ~12. Peak observed during rollouts: 210 concurrent requests for short bursts (~10 minutes) during a campaign.
- Token mix (measured on trial): ~62% short-turn chat/assist (~30-80 tokens per request), ~28% medium summaries/ranking (~200-450 tokens), ~10% long synthesis (>800 tokens) coming from weekly batch jobs.
- Avg token consumption/day: ~3.8M input + 5.1M output tokens. Peak day 11M total tokens.
- Latency targets: product team requires p95 <= 350ms for interactive chat, p99 <= 700ms acceptable for heavy requests. Trial p95 at Hosted API was ~420ms for default model; with streaming they saw perceived latency improvement for users.

Dedicated sizing considerations (requested from AE/SE):
- Baseline capacity target: sustain 60 QPS with p95 <= 350ms for model variant A.
- Burst capacity: absorb short spikes up to 250 concurrent requests (1-2 minute bursts) without throttling.
- Token mix for capacity planning: project 25% growth Y/Y; assume average request size grows 10% as more summarization shipped.
- Memory/kv-cache needs: chat sessions use 6-12k tokens of context for some power users; recommended capacity for high-ttl KV cache nodes.
- Preferred model families: open models (Llama 3-ish), willing to run quantized variants if Redwood provides verified perf profiles. Need fallback routing to smaller cheaper models during large-scale campaigns.

Procurement & compliance notes:
- Must have SSO (SAML) integration and audit logs with 12-month retention.
- Data residency: primary requirement US-only but enterprise legal wants options for EU residents; request for clarifying Redwood Private vs Dedicated residency guarantees.
- KMS integration required (customer-managed keys preferred).

Conversations & quotes:
- Pricing sensitivity: moderate; willing to invest in Dedicated if unit token cost halves vs Hosted at current throughput and if predictable latency guaranteed.
- Requested a 12-month reserved capacity quote + burst provisioning. AE provided a preliminary estimate sheet (drive:/deals/signalharbor/2026-pricing-deck.pdf).

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2025-11-10: Hosted API trial kickoff (dev & product).
- 2025-12-08: Feature demo for execs; Clara asked for SLA details. (ff-3492-signalharbor-demo)
